title: NS Clipper v1.1.10
release_notes: NS Clipper v1.1.10: Gemini Interactions API schema fix, Deepgram isolation, Nova-3 pinning, 300s timeout, duplicate Qt signal guard, model registry alignment.
changelog:
# NS Clipper v1.1.10

## Critical AI Provider Fixes
- Gemini Interactions API Schema: Migrated to root input parameter, snake_case generation_config, and audio items type audio.
- Gemini 400 Payload Error Fast-Fail: Zero key rotations on schema errors, single Files API upload, and remote audio cleanup in finally.
- Gemini 404 Route: Auto-fallback to gemini-3.6-flash without invalid key rotation.
- Deepgram Nova-3 Isolation: Isolated raw binary audio requests (/v1/listen), zero Gemini JSON payload pollution, and typed error classifications.
- Large Audio Timeout: Deepgram timeout set to 300s to handle 24.53 MB audio files.

## UI & Engine Fixes
- Duplicate Qt Signal Guard: Prevents duplicate progress bar updates and concurrent worker leaks.
- Update Dialog Formatting: Correctly formats patch download sizes (e.g. 135.6 KB instead of 0.0 MB).
- Central Model Registry: Find Viral Clips uses Gemini 3.6 Flash, Transcribe uses Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, Deepgram uses Nova-3.

## Upgrade & Compatibility Policy
- v1.1.9 users receive atomic patch (135.6 KB).
- v1.1.8 and earlier: full installer required.
- Preserved: All settings, licenses, project workspaces, and API keys remain 100% untouched.
_note: v1.1.9 receives patch if base hashes validate; v1.1.8 and earlier always receive full installer; unknown/modified installations always receive full installer.
